intro: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor tasks Alliance champions with striking an encampment of Dragonmaw orcs northeast of the town and claiming their war banners. The remnant orcs, broken and scattered after the Second War, have begun gathering strength once again in the bogs of the Wetlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.
Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.
We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you attacked the Dragonmaw encampment?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well fought, friend. The Dragonmaws are not the same threat they were when they had dragons, but they're still fierce opponents.

The Dragonmaws are led by Nek'rosh, son of Nekros, who was the former head of the Dragonmaws years ago. Nekros used powerful magic to tame the Red Dragons, but when that magic failed him...the dragons were not happy.
Nekros was killed, and his son has vowed revenge against the dragons who slew his father.
